popCulture.title: Antigone
popCulture.creator: Sophocles
popCulture.description: Creon's queen hears of Haemon's death and takes her own life offstage — the silent mother whose suicide closes the Theban catastrophe. Not Orpheus' Eurydice.

popCulture.title: Eurydice (wife of Creon)
popCulture.description: Queen of Thebes in Sophocles' Antigone — distinct from Eurydice wife of Orpheus.
